new_jobs.title: Retail Manager, Taiwan

strategies, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve business objectives. **Job Responsibilities** **Business Development:** * Develop and execute retail strategies aligned with global business objectives to achieve and exceed sales targets across all stores in Taiwan. * Proactively monitor and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) to identify areas for improvement and implement data-driven action plans to optimize business performance. * Conduct thorough market analysis, monitoring competitor activities and identifying emerging trends to capitalize on growth opportunities. * Maintain expert knowledge of RIMOWA's product categories and collections, leveraging insights to develop and implement effective sales strategies that align with brand direction. * Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams (marketing, merchandising, client care) to ensure seamless execution of retail strategies and alignment with overall company goals. * Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with key partners, stakeholders, and landlords to build a robust network that supports business growth and brand presence. **Team Management and Development:** * Serve as the voice of Taiwan retail, providing valuable insights and recommendations to support strategic decision-making for the region. * Build, lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing retail team, fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement. * Inspire, motivate, and empower the team to achieve and surpass company goals, creating a positive and rewarding work environment. * Cultivate a collaborative and inclusive team environment, reinforcing a shared vision and fostering a strong sense of belonging and engagement. * Provide ongoing coaching, training, and performance management to support team members' professional growth and development. * Act as a trusted and respected leader, setting a positive example through professionalism, dedication, and commitment to RIMOWA's values. * Partner with the HR team to continuously evolve recruitment and retention practices, attracting and retaining top talent in the market. * Liaise effectively with all stakeholders and departments at both local and HQ levels, leveraging available resources to achieve business objectives and ensure seamless operations. **Client Experience and Satisfaction:** * Champion a service-driven culture with a client-centric mindset, empowering teams to drive business growth through innovation and exceptional customer service. * Ensure the highest level of client service is consistently delivered across all retail locations, implementing and upholding RIMOWA's luxury selling ceremony, client service standards, and personalized client outreach programs. * Collaborate closely with the Client Care team to implement exceptional in-store client care and after-sales service experiences. * Implement and monitor client feedback mechanisms to identify areas for improvement and drive continuous enhancement of client satisfaction. **Operational Excellence:** * Oversee retail operations, including inventory management, store layout, and visual merchandising, to maximize efficiency, profitability, and brand consistency. * Ensure full compliance with company policies, procedures, and audit requirements, maintaining the highest standards of operational integrity. * Maintain consistently high standards of in-store operations, ensuring alignment with company guidelines and brand standards. * Lead the implementation of continuous training programs for store management and staff on operating procedures, ensuring efficient and effective store operations. **Profile** * Minimum 5-7 years of experience in multi-store management, with a strong preference for experience in luxury retail. A plus for candidates with experience in liaising with HQ. * Exceptional problem-solving, decision-making, planning, organizing, interpersonal, presentation, and communication skills. * Demonstrated strong business acumen and awareness of market trends in Taiwan. * Highly self-motivated with a high capacity for multi-tasking, thriving in a fast-paced environment with a strong drive for continuous improvement. * Possesses a proactive, "can-do" attitude with strong initiative, able to work effectively under pressure and meet deadlines. * Proficient in MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook). * Fluency in English is required.

new_jobs.title: Senior / Retail Operations Executive, Taiwan
new_jobs.jd: **Position** RIMOWA is looking for a Retail Operations Executive to support RIMOWA’s retail growth acceleration in Taiwan. The Retail Operations Executive supports the Retail Manager in overseeing the daily operations of our retail store(s), ensuring a high standard of customer service, operational efficiency, and alignment with company guidelines. This role is pivotal in driving sales performance, fostering team collaboration, and maintaining strong relationships with external vendors and internal stakeholders. **Job Responsibilities** * Operational Support: + Assist Retail Manager in planning, organizing, and directing operational activities. + Implement and maintain operational policies and procedures. + Ensure compliance with all relevant regulations and company standards. + Manage the supply of essential items, including staff uniforms, packaging material & store supplies, ensuring adequate stock levels and timely replenishment. + Coordinate with other departments to ensure timely and efficient flow of materials and resources. + Coordinate maintenance and repair activities for store facilities and equipment, ensuring a safe and functional environment for employees and customers. * Process Improvement: + Identify opportunities to streamline operational processes and improve efficiency. + Assist in developing and implementing process improvements and best practices. + Conduct regular store visits to assess compliance with established standards and identify areas for improvement. * Reporting & Analysis: + Compile and analyze sales data to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for improvement + Prepare regular reports on operational performance, highlighting key achievements and areas for concern. * Financial Administration: + Provide support in managing budgets and controlling operational costs. + Monitor operational expenditures against approved budgets, identifying and addressing any variances. + Reviewing invoices for various operational expenses, including uniform cleaning, cash collection services, and shopping bag orders, ensuring accuracy and adherence to company policies. + Manage monthly mall reimbursement requests, compiling necessary documentation and ensuring timely submission. * Inventory Management: + Proactively monitor store stock levels (primarily non-suitcase items) to anticipate demand and prevent stockouts. + Troubleshoot any logistical issues or delays, proactively identifying and implementing solutions to minimize disruption. + Assist with the planning and execution of annual stock take. * Projects & Initiatives: + Support store opening and renovation projects as needed, assisting with planning, coordination, and execution to ensure projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the required standards. **Profile** * Bachelor degree with 3+ years related experience, preferably in a luxury or high-end retail environment. Candidate with more experience will be considered as Senior Retail Operations Executive. * Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills. * Excellent organizational and time-management abilities. * Ability to work independently and as part of a team. * Good command of both spoken and written English and Mandarin. * Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

The successful candidate will operate at the intersection of product architecture, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and business strategy and will help shape products from early architecture through development, qualification, manufacturing ramp, and deployment at scale. This role is for a technical HW TPM leader who thrives in fast‑moving, highly complex environments. Cross-Organizational Leadership * Build partnerships across Microsoft engineering and business organizations, creating alignment and accountability across organizational and geographic boundaries. * Provide strategic direction to large cross-org teams and work effectively with CVP-level leaders and technical and business stakeholders. * Establish scalable operating mechanisms across Redmond, Taipei, and the broader global engineering ecosystem. * Lead strategic engagement with ODMs, OEMs, JDMs, key strategic sub-systems/component suppliers, and manufacturing partners across Taiwan and Asia. * Drive alignment and resolution on highly complex technical, execution, manufacturing, quality, and supply-chain issues requiring decisions across organizational boundaries. sponsorship, stretch assignments, and deliberate talent development. **Qualifications** Required Qualifications * Bachelor's Degree AND 12+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development OR equivalent experience. * 5+ years people management experience. * 9+ years experience managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects. **Preferred Qualifications** * Bachelor's Degree AND 15+ years experience engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development OR equivalent experience. * 8+ years people management experience. * 12+ years experience managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects. * 1+ year experience reading and/or writing code. * Demonstrated experience leading multiple generations of complex hardware products from concept and architecture through NPI, qualification, production ramp, and deployment at scale. * Deep technical understanding in one or more areas of AI infrastructure, accelerated computing, server/rack architecture, networking, power delivery, thermal/liquid cooling, silicon, or complex electromechanical systems. * Systems-engineering and solution-thinking capability with demonstrated ability to influence product architecture and complex technical trade-offs. * Experience leading geographically distributed technical organizations across the U.S. and Asia. * Extensive experience working with the Taiwan hardware ecosystem, including ODMs, OEMs, JDMs, manufacturing partners, and component suppliers. * Proven ability to build and new_jobs.title: Artificial Intelligent (AI) Engineer
new_jobs.jd: As a fast-growing startup building a next-generation platform for the gig economy, Flexii is looking for an AI Engineer to develop our AI interview system as well as to extend our long-term AI roadmap. You will build intelligent systems that not only automate recruitment but also streamline internal operations. This is a "build-from-zero" role in a collaborative, hands-on environment. **Key Responsibilities** AI Product & Feature Development * AI Interview Engine: Design and deploy conversational agents using Gemini and Vertex AI to conduct automated screenings and evaluate candidate fit. * Operational AI (SOP Generation): Build LLM-driven workflows that transform raw process notes into structured Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). * Intelligent Data Retrieval: Develop RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems or newer systems to allow staff to query internal documentation and databases using natural language. * Evaluation & Testing: Implement A/B testing and evaluation frameworks to measure the accuracy and impact of AI-generated outputs. AI Infrastructure * Hybrid Data Architecture: Manage and optimize data flows between PostgreSQL (structured logic), MongoDB (unstructured transcripts/SOPs), and BigQuery (long-term analytics). * Vector Ops: Implement and maintain vector databases and embeddings (e.g., Gemini Embeddings) to power semantic search and retrieval across the platform. * Backend Integration: Collaborate with engineering to build robust APIs and ensure seamless integration with our Flutter frontend. * Scalability & Governance: Monitor AI costs and performance, ensuring data privacy and PII handling follow best practices. Additional Scope (as the data function grows) * Support AI needs for product experimentation and growth initiatives. * Document AI models, pipelines, and business logic for team knowledge sharing. * Stay up-to-date with new AI tools and best practices; suggest improvements to our stack as we scale. **Requirements** * Experience: 3+ years of experience in AI engineering, backend engineering, or a closely related technical role. * Generative AI: Strong proficiency with Large Language Models (LLMs), specifically the Gemini API and prompt engineering. * Database Management: Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL and MongoDB; knowledge of how to structure data for AI consumption. * Cloud Infrastructure: Proficiency in the Google Cloud Platform (GCP) ecosystem (Vertex AI, Cloud Functions, BigQuery). * Technical Literacy: Awareness of software development practices including APIs, Git, and collaborating with Flutter/Frontend teams. * Startup Mindset: Proactive, self-motivated, and comfortable "wearing multiple hats" to build systems from scratch. **Nice-to-Haves** * Agentic Frameworks: Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar tools for building complex AI agents. * Vector Search: Exposure to vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Vertex AI Search) for high-performance data retrieval. * Domain Experience: Prior work in marketplace platforms, HR-tech, or business process automation. **What We Offer** * The opportunity to shape the AI strategy of a scaling startup. * A collaborative environment where your work directly impacts product and operational efficiency.

new_jobs.jd: 【Client Description】 法國巴黎知名美妝集團，旗下擁有多個國際知名品牌，致力於提供創新美妝產品與多元消費體驗，並持續以數位行銷與消費者洞察驅動品牌成長。 【加分條件 | Preferred Qualifications】 * 具有 FMCG (快速消費品) 或美妝保養產業的經驗，對市場動態有深入了解。 * 熟悉CPD主要零售通路（如：藥妝店、電商、量販店等）的運作模式。 * 具備良好的英文溝通能力 【工作內容 | Scope of Work】 * 通路行銷策略發展與執行 (Strategy & Execution): 協同行銷與業務團隊，依據品牌年度策略，發展各通路的行銷計畫與活動檔期。 規劃與管理所負責品類的促銷活動(Promotion Guideline) 負責通路新品上市的相關規劃與執行，確保新品在店內獲得最佳曝光與消費者觸及。 * 通路行銷相關小樣試用品與贈品規劃與執行 (PLV & GWP) 協同Shopper Activation Marketing團隊，依據通路行銷活動計畫，發展與執行各通路的贈品需求 結合通路行銷策略，規劃與執行所負責品類的小樣試用品(PLV) * 數據分析與洞察及FCST管理 (Data Analysis & FCST Management): 核心職責： 深入分析各通路及所負責品類的銷售數據與庫存情況 (Sell-in/Sell-out/Stock), 並對未來業績及商品貨量預估提出建議 從龐雜的數據中提煉出商業洞察 (Business Insights)，例如發現潛在的成長機會、識別銷售下滑的原因等。 定期製作通路表現分析報告，並以清晰的邏輯向內部團隊（包含行銷、業務及管理層）進行匯報，作為未來決策的依據。 * 跨部門溝通 (Cross-functional Communication) 核心職責： 作為主要溝通窗口，與行銷、業務、供應鏈、財務等不同部門的夥伴密切協作，確保通路活動順暢推行。 展現強大的 ownership，主動發起並追蹤所負責品類相關業務進度，提前預見潛在風險並找出解決方案，確保所有專案能如期、如質地完成。 有效管理通路行銷活動的預算，並追蹤活動成效 (ROI)，持續優化資源配置。

new_jobs.title: Engineering Manager
new_jobs.jd: **About the Company:** Our client is an international technology company developing advanced AI-powered solutions for enterprise customers. Operating in a dynamic, high-growth environment, the organization focuses on building scalable, secure, and production-ready AI applications and platforms. **About the Role:** We are seeking an experienced **R&D Lead** to lead a global engineering team (3 locations) and drive the successful development and delivery of innovative AI products. Working closely with Product Management, you will translate product roadmaps into high-quality, production-ready releases, ensuring technical excellence, predictable delivery, and continuous improvement. You will also serve as the team's **AI subject matter expert** , providing technical leadership on model selection, fine-tuning, retrieval architectures, evaluation frameworks, and scalable AI systems. This is a **hands-on player-coach role** , suited to someone who combines proven engineering leadership with practical experience designing, building, and deploying machine learning systems at scale. The position requires adaptability, strong collaboration skills, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, multicultural environment with geographically distributed teams. Key Responsibilities Engineering Leadership & Team Development * Lead, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary team of AI, platform, and software engineers. * Establish high engineering standards and promote a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement. * Support recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and team development as the organization grows. * Provide hands-on technical guidance and help resolve complex engineering challenges. AI Technical Leadership * Serve as the team's AI subject matter expert, defining technical direction and architectural best practices. * Guide decisions on LLMs, model selection, fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agentic AI architectures. * Oversee model evaluation, optimization, deployment, and monitoring to ensure reliable production performance. * Drive the development of scalable, maintainable, and secure AI systems. * Participate actively in architecture discussions, technical reviews, and critical engineering decisions. Product Delivery & Execution * Own end-to-end engineering delivery, from planning and development through deployment and post-release quality. * Collaborate closely with Product Management on roadmap execution, prioritization, scope, and technical trade-offs. * Lead agile delivery practices, including sprint planning, estimation, dependency management, and progress reporting. * Establish and continuously improve engineering processes, including code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, and release management. * Identify technical and delivery risks early, implement mitigation plans, and maintain transparent communication with stakeholders. * Ensure products meet enterprise standards for performance, reliability, security, and scalability. Cross-Functional Collaboration * Collaborate with product, engineering, and business stakeholders across different locations and time zones. * Build alignment across diverse teams, working styles, and cultural perspectives. * Adapt priorities and processes as business and product requirements evolve. * Communicate technical decisions, progress, and challenges clearly to both technical and executive audiences. **Required Qualifications & Experience** * Proven experience leading engineering teams responsible for delivering production-grade software or AI products. * Strong hands-on background in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and scalable software engineering. * Deep knowledge of LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), fine-tuning, and model evaluation. * Demonstrated experience owning engineering delivery, including planning, execution, release management, and quality assurance. * Strong Python programming skills, with the ability to review, troubleshoot, and contribute to production code. * Experience with MLOps, model deployment, monitoring, and continuous optimization. * Solid understanding of software architecture, system design, engineering best practices, and CI/CD. * Experience collaborating with Product Owners or Product Managers in agile development environments. * Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to balance technical depth with delivery commitments. * An agile and adaptable mindset, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, changing priorities, and evolving business needs. * Excellent interpersonal and cross-cultural collaboration skills, with experience influencing geographically distributed teams. * Strong communication skills, including the ability to engage effectively with senior stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience developing or deploying agentic AI systems and LLM-powered applications. * Background in platform engineering, infrastructure, model serving, or developer platforms. * Knowledge of security engineering and secure-by-design development practices. * Experience delivering technology solutions for enterprise customers or regulated industries. * Experience managing engineering teams across multiple countries and time zones. * Familiarity with private-cloud, on-premises, or highly secure AI deployment environments. * Previous experience scaling engineering teams in high-growth or evolving technology organizations. The Opportunity This role offers the opportunity to combine hands-on AI expertise with engineering leadership, shape technical decisions, and take ownership of the delivery of advanced AI solutions. The successful candidate will play a key role in building a high-performing engineering team and translating ambitious product objectives into reliable, scalable technology.
